question: Which renowned personality received the 2025 Templeton Prize for promoting science and spirituality?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew**, a global leader of the Orthodox Christian Church, is recognized for his contributions towards promoting **science and spirituality**.
 
• He was awarded the **2025 Templeton Prize**, which honors individuals whose work has advanced the intersection of science and religion.
 
• Patriarch Bartholomew has been an advocate for **environmental sustainability**, often referred to as the "Green Patriarch" for his efforts in connecting ecology with theology.
 
• His initiatives emphasize the need for **spiritual reflection** on environmental issues, urging global communities to adopt sustainable practices.
 
• The Templeton Prize, established by Sir John Templeton, is one of the world's largest annual awards in monetary terms, celebrating work that bridges gaps between **science, philosophy, and religion.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew:**

 
 
• He is the **Archbishop of Constantinople-New Rome** and Ecumenical Patriarch, serving as the spiritual leader of approximately 300 million Orthodox Christians worldwide.
 
• He has played a significant role in fostering interfaith dialogue and promoting **peaceful coexistence** among different religious groups.
 
• His efforts include organizing environmental conferences and advocating for **climate justice**.
 
• Bartholomew has consistently highlighted the moral and spiritual dimensions of environmental degradation.
 
 
 
• **Templeton Prize:**
 
 
• Established in **1972** by Sir John Templeton, the award recognizes individuals making exceptional contributions to affirming life's spiritual dimension.
 
• It is awarded annually and includes a monetary value higher than the Nobel Prizes to reflect Sir Templeton's belief in the importance of spiritual contributions.
 
• Past recipients include influential figures like **Mother Teresa**, **Dalai Lama**, and **Francis Collins**.
 
 
 
• **Intersection of Science and Spirituality:**
 
 
• Science and spirituality often intersect in addressing global challenges like **climate change, ethics in scientific advancements, and human well-being.**
 
• Prominent leaders like Patriarch Bartholomew work to show how **spiritual teachings** can complement scientific understanding.
 
• Such initiatives promote a holistic approach to solving societal issues by combining **technological innovation with moral responsibility.**
 
 
 
• **Environmental Advocacy:**
 
 
• Patriarch Bartholomew's environmental advocacy includes emphasizing the responsibility of individuals and communities to care for the Earth.
 
• He has highlighted the theological perspective that the environment is a **gift from God**, necessitating stewardship and respect.
 
• His work aligns with broader movements promoting **sustainability, renewable energy, and conservation.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **William Lane Craig:** Known for contributions to **Christian philosophy and apologetics**, but not associated with the Templeton Prize in 2025.
 
• **Jean Vanier:** A founder of L'Arche communities for individuals with intellectual disabilities, his work primarily focuses on **social inclusion** rather than science and spirituality.
 
• **Francis Collins:** A geneticist and former director of the National Institutes of Health (NIH), awarded the Templeton Prize in **2020**.
 
• **Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomew:** Correct answer, awarded the **2025 Templeton Prize** for his efforts in integrating spirituality with environmental science.
